FRAGILE_PACKING_RULE_CONTENT.CONTENT1: If you're sending or transporting fragile items, proper packaging is essential to avoid damage during transit.
FRAGILE_PACKING_RULE_CONTENT.PRACTICE_LIST1: Wrap each item individually using bubble wrap, foam, or protective padding.
FRAGILE_PACKING_RULE_CONTENT.PRACTICE_LIST2: Use a sturdy box — double-wall cardboard boxes are ideal.
FRAGILE_PACKING_RULE_CONTENT.PRACTICE_LIST3: Fill empty spaces with cushioning materials like crumpled paper or packing peanuts to prevent movement.
FRAGILE_PACKING_RULE_CONTENT.PRACTICE_LIST4: Seal securely using strong tape on all edges and seams.
FRAGILE_PACKING_RULE_CONTENT.PRACTICE_LIST5: Clearly mark the parcel with a 'Fragile' label on multiple sides.
FRAGILE_PACKING_RULE_CONTENT.PROTIP_DESC: Add photos of the packaging before sealing — this helps with insurance and dispute resolution if issues arise.
FRAGILE_PACKING_RULE_CONTENT.AVOID_DESC: Avoid packing glassware, electronics, or ceramic items loosely or with inadequate protection

DO_NOT_OPEN_PACKAGE_CONTENT.DESC1: For safety, trust, and legal reasons, parcels must never be opened during transportation.
DO_NOT_OPEN_PACKAGE_CONTENT.DESC2: Opening a package without consent is a violation of Postier’s code of conduct and may lead to suspension or legal action.
DO_NOT_OPEN_PACKAGE_CONTENT.DESC3: If a package seems suspicious or damaged, report it immediately to support — do not open it yourself.

HANDLE_WITH_CARE_CONTENT.SUBTITLE: Careful Handling Is Key to Safe Delivery
HANDLE_WITH_CARE_CONTENT.INTRO: As a Postier, you're trusted with packages that may include fragile, perishable, sensitive, or sentimental items. To ensure a smooth and professional delivery:
HANDLE_WITH_CARE_CONTENT.GUIDELINES1: Lift with both hands and avoid sudden movements.
HANDLE_WITH_CARE_CONTENT.GUIDELINES2: Secure parcels properly in your vehicle or bag to prevent shifting during transport.
HANDLE_WITH_CARE_CONTENT.GUIDELINES3: Do not place heavy parcels on top of lighter or fragile ones.
HANDLE_WITH_CARE_CONTENT.GUIDELINES4: Avoid exposure to excessive heat, moisture, or vibrations.
HANDLE_WITH_CARE_CONTENT.GUIDELINES5: Never throw, drop, or squeeze parcels.
HANDLE_WITH_CARE_CONTENT.REMINDER: Reminder: Handling parcels with respect and care builds trust between you, the sender, and the receiver — and it ensures your continued success as a Postier.

CUSTOMER_RESPECT_CONTENT.SUBTITLE: Respect Builds Trust
CUSTOMER_RESPECT_CONTENT.INTRO: Whether you're a sender, receiver, or Postier, treating each other with respect ensures a safe, supportive, and reliable community.
CUSTOMER_RESPECT_CONTENT.GUIDELINES2: Be patient and understanding with questions or delays.
CUSTOMER_RESPECT_CONTENT.GUIDELINES3: Show appreciation for each other's time and effort.
CUSTOMER_RESPECT_CONTENT.GUIDELINES4: ❌ Avoid offensive language, aggressive behavior, or making assumptions.
CUSTOMER_RESPECT_CONTENT.REMINDER: Remember: Behind every parcel is a person. A little kindness goes a long way in making every delivery a positive experience.

CONTACT_SUPPORT_CONTENT.SUBTITLE: Lost, confused, or facing an issue? We’ve got your back.
CONTACT_SUPPORT_CONTENT.DESC: Our Customer Support Team is available to assist you with:
CONTACT_SUPPORT_CONTENT.POINTS_1: Go to “Help Center” in the app or website
CONTACT_SUPPORT_CONTENT.POINTS_2: Choose a topic or tap “Contact Support”
CONTACT_SUPPORT_CONTENT.POINTS_3: Use email (support@postier.org) – we’ll respond as quickly as possible
CONTACT_SUPPORT_CONTENT.END: We’re here to help you every step of the way — before, during, and after your delivery.

TRAVEL_SAFELY_CONTENT.SUBTITLE: Your safety comes first — every trip, every time.
TRAVEL_SAFELY_CONTENT.INTRO: To ensure safe and secure parcel delivery, please follow these best practices:
TRAVEL_SAFELY_CONTENT.GUIDELINES1: Plan your route ahead of time and check traffic or weather updates.
TRAVEL_SAFELY_CONTENT.GUIDELINES2: Take regular breaks to avoid fatigue on long journeys.
TRAVEL_SAFELY_CONTENT.GUIDELINES3: Secure parcels properly to avoid damage or distraction while driving.
TRAVEL_SAFELY_CONTENT.GUIDELINES4: Never rush deliveries — it's better to be safe and a few minutes late.
TRAVEL_SAFELY_CONTENT.GUIDELINES5: Avoid distractions: use hands-free mode if you must take a call.
TRAVEL_SAFELY_CONTENT.GUIDELINES6: Share your trip with a trusted contact for extra peace of mind.
TRAVEL_SAFELY_CONTENT.REMINDER: If you ever feel unsafe or suspect suspicious activity, pause the delivery and contact Postier Support immediately.

DECLINE_A_SAFELY_CONTENT.SUBTITLE: If you're unable to fulfill a delivery request, you can decline it with confidence.
DECLINE_A_SAFELY_CONTENT.GUIDELINES2: Parcel size or weight exceeds your preference
DECLINE_A_SAFELY_CONTENT.GUIDELINES3: Concerns about the type of parcel
DECLINE_A_SAFELY_CONTENT.GUIDELINES4: Route or location is out of your way
DECLINE_A_SAFELY_CONTENT.REMINDER: You can add a short note to help the sender understand your decision. Being transparent helps maintain a respectful and trusted community.

REVIEW_SAFELY_CONTENT.SUBTITLE: Before you accept a delivery offer from a Postier, take a moment to carefully review the request to ensure everything matches your expectations.
REVIEW_SAFELY_CONTENT.REMINDER: Make sure your parcel is well-described and properly packaged before confirming. Clear communication leads to smoother deliveries!

INSPECT_SAFELY_CONTENT.LIST1: Check the parcel for any visible damage or signs of tampering.
INSPECT_SAFELY_CONTENT.LIST2: Take photos if anything looks suspicious or differs from the expected condition.
INSPECT_SAFELY_CONTENT.LIST3: Verify the contents match what was expected (if applicable).
INSPECT_SAFELY_CONTENT.SOMETHING_SEEMS_DESC: Contact Customer Support immediately through the Help Center for assistance with dispute resolution. We're here to help protect your delivery experience.
INSPECT_SAFELY_CONTENT.TIPS: Tip: Confirming delivery closes the transaction, so it's best to inspect before accepting.

REVIEW_OFFER_SAFELY_CONTENT.INTRO: Before accepting a delivery request, carefully review all parcel details including:
REVIEW_OFFER_SAFELY_CONTENT.GUIDELINE2: Parcel size, weight, and type (e.g., fragile or perishable)
REVIEW_OFFER_SAFELY_CONTENT.REMINDER: Accept only if you're confident and available for the delivery

HANDLE_FRAGILE_SAFELY_CONTENT.DESC: If a parcel is marked as fragile, please take the following precautions:
HANDLE_FRAGILE_SAFELY_CONTENT.PRECAUTION1: Check for proper packaging before accepting it. If it's not safely packed, advise the sender to repack it.
HANDLE_FRAGILE_SAFELY_CONTENT.PRECAUTION2: Place fragile parcels on top of heavier items during transport to avoid pressure or damage.
HANDLE_FRAGILE_SAFELY_CONTENT.SUSPICIOUS: If a parcel appears suspicious or unsafe to transport, do not proceed — report it through the app and contact support immediately.
HANDLE_FRAGILE_SAFELY_CONTENT.NOTE: Your safety and the parcel’s condition matter equally. Take a moment to inspect, protect, and handle with care.

DECLINING_DELIVERY_SAFELY_CONTENT.SUBTITLE: If you’ve received an offer from a Postier that doesn’t meet your expectations, you can safely decline it.
DECLINING_DELIVERY_SAFELY_CONTENT.INTRO: Here are a few reasons you might decline:
DECLINING_DELIVERY_SAFELY_CONTENT.GUIDELLINES2: The delivery time doesn’t match your needs
DECLINING_DELIVERY_SAFELY_CONTENT.GUIDELLINES3: The Postier’s profile or rating doesn’t meet your trust level
DECLINING_DELIVERY_SAFELY_CONTENT.REMINDER: Tip: Add a short message when declining to help the Postier understand your decision — it supports respectful communication and improves future interactions.

NEW.HOW_DO_SEND_PARCEL: How do I send a parcel?
NEW.HOW_DO_SEND_PARCEL_CONTENT: Unlock the convenience of our services by visiting our website or app to create your account today! Once you're logged in, effortlessly create a parcel by simply filling out the required fields. Experience seamless shipping like never before!
NEW.CAN_I_TRACK_CONTENT: Yes! You get real-time status updates + access to tracking via your Postier account or mobile app.
NEW.IS_MY_PARCEL: Is my parcel insured during delivery?
NEW.IS_MY_PARCEL_CONTENT: Yes, Postier requires all travelers to pass identity verification, and tracking is monitored. Additional insurance options will be available soon!
NEW.POSTIERS_GET_PAID_CONTENT: After pickup and delivery QR code confirmation, payouts are processed within 24–48 hours.
NEW.HOW_DO_I_SEND: How do I send a parcel with Postier?
NEW.HOW_DO_I_SEND_CONTENT: You can send a parcel by creating a shipment request on our platform. Simply enter pickup and drop-off details, parcel size/weight, choose a Postier traveler, and confirm your booking.
NEW.WHAT_KIND_OF_PARCELS: What kind of parcels can I send?
NEW.WHAT_KIND_OF_PARCELS_CONTENT: You can send standard parcels, fragile items, oversized packages, and temperature-sensitive goods, as long as they comply with legal and safety regulations. Hazardous or prohibited items are not allowed.
NEW.HOW_IS_THE_DELIVERY: How is the delivery price calculated?
NEW.HOW_IS_THE_DELIVERY_CONTENT_LI5: Discounts for long-distance or heavy parcels
NEW.HOW_DO_I_PAY: How do I pay for my delivery?
NEW.HOW_DO_I_PAY_CONTENT: Payments are processed securely via Stripe. You can pay with credit/debit cards, Klarna, or optionally Cash on Delivery (COD) or Cash on Pickup (COP) if available.
NEW.IS_MY_PARCEL_INSURED_CONTENT: Currently, insurance cannot be booked directly on the platform. We are working on making insurance options available in the future to provide senders with additional peace of mind.
NEW.HOW_DO_I_TRACK: How do I track my parcel?
NEW.CAN_I_CANCEL_LI2: Full refund if cancelled more than 24h before pickup
NEW.CAN_I_CANCEL_LI3: Partial refund if cancelled less than 24h before pickup
NEW.CAN_I_CANCEL_LI4: No refund if delivery has already started or the Postier has arrived at pickup
NEW.MY_POSTIER_CANCLES: What happens if my Postier cancels?
NEW.MY_POSTIER_CANCLES_CONTENT: If a Postier cancels, you will be fully refunded and can rebook with another traveler.
NEW.HOW_DO_I_COMMUNICATE: How do I communicate with my Postier?
NEW.HOW_DO_I_COMMUNICATE_CONTENT: You can chat directly with your Postier through the secure messaging system in your account dashboard.
NEW.CAN_I_LEAVE_A_REVIEW: Can I leave a review after delivery?
NEW.CAN_I_LEAVE_A_REVIEW_CONTENT: Yes, after your parcel is delivered, you can rate and review the Postier. Reviews help build trust and ensure high-quality deliveries.
NEW.HOW_DO_I_EARN: How do I earn with Postier?
NEW.HOW_DO_I_EARN_CONTENT: You earn by delivering parcels during your planned trips. Senders pay securely through Postier, and your payout is released once the parcel is delivered and confirmed.
NEW.I_GET_PAID_CONTENT_LI1: Direct deposit to your credit/debit card via Stripe
NEW.I_GET_PAID_CONTENT_LI2: Bank transfer through Stripe payout system
NEW.I_GET_PAID_CONTENT_LI4: Cash on Delivery (COD) or Cash on Pickup (COP) (optional, if the sender selected this method)
NEW.I_GET_PAID_CONTENT_P2: You’ll receive a confirmation email with payment details each time a payout is made.
NEW.WHAT_KIND_OF_PARCEL: What kind of parcels can I carry?
NEW.WHAT_KIND_OF_PARCEL_CONTENT: You can carry standard, fragile, oversized, or temperature-sensitive parcels, depending on your preferences. You can also set a maximum weight per parcel to fit your safety and comfort.
NEW.DO_I_NEED: Do I need to change my travel plans?
NEW.DO_I_NEED_CONTENT: No. Postier is built for you to earn extra money on trips you’re already making. You just add your route and available space.
NEW.CAN_I_DECLINE_CONTENT: Yes. You are free to accept or decline parcel requests. However, frequent cancellations or declines without valid reasons may affect your reliability score.
NEW.IS_INSURANCE_CONTENT: Currently, no insurance is required. Senders should ensure parcels are packaged securely. Insurance options will be added in the future.
NEW.SUSPICIOUS_CONTENT: What if I suspect suspicious content?
NEW.SUSPICIOUS_CONTENT_CONTENT: Do not accept or transport suspicious parcels. Immediately report them using Postier’s support system. Your safety comes first.
NEW.DELIVERY_IS_DELAYED: What if my delivery is delayed?
NEW.DELIVERY_IS_DELAYED_CONTENT: You must inform the sender and receiver right away using Postier’s in-app messaging. Transparency builds trust and helps prevent disputes.
NEW.REVIEW_A_POSTIER: Can I get reviews as a Postier?
NEW.REVIEW_A_POSTIER_CONTENT: Yes. After successful deliveries, senders and receivers can rate you. A good rating means more trust and visibility on the platform.
NEW.DELETE_TRIP: Can I delete a trip after posting it?
NEW.DELETE_TRIP_CONTENT: Yes. Trips can be deleted if they have not yet started.  However, frequent deletions or cancellations without valid reasons may affect your reliability score and visibility on the platform.
NEW.HOW_CAN_POSTIER: How can I be an Postier?
NEW.HOW_CAN_POSTIER_CONTENT: After pickup and delivery QR code confirmation, payouts are processed within 24–48 hours.
NEW.VIEW_MY_EARNINGS: How Can I View My Earnings?
NEW.VIEW_MY_EARNINGS_CONTENT: Choose 'Express' or 'Same-Day' delivery options when creating your parcel request.
NEW.SWITCH_TO_CUSTOMER: How to switch from Postier to Customer?
NEW.SWITCH_TO_CUSTOMER_CONTENT: Choose 'Express' or 'Same-Day' delivery options when creating your parcel request.
NEW.HOW_WILL_I_KNOW: How will I know when my parcel is arriving?
NEW.HOW_WILL_I_KNOW_CONTENT: You’ll receive notifications and tracking updates as soon as the parcel is on its way. You can track it in real-time with the provided tracking ID.
NEW.WHAT_DO_I_NEED: What do I need to do at drop-off?
NEW.WHAT_DO_I_NEED_CONTENT: At delivery, you must present and confirm the QR code or delivery code provided by Postier application. This ensures secure handover and triggers Postier’s payment release.
NEW.CAN_I_PARCEL: Can I inspect the parcel before accepting it?
NEW.CAN_I_PARCEL_CONTENT: Yes. Please inspect your parcel at delivery. If there are issues, contact customer support immediately before confirming receipt.
NEW.DO_I_PAY: Do I pay anything at delivery?
NEW.DO_I_PAY_CONTENT: No extra payments are required unless you booked Cash on Delivery (COD) or Cash on Pickup (COP). Otherwise, all payments are processed securely upfront.
NEW.PARCEL_IS_DAMAGED: What if my parcel is damaged?
NEW.PARCEL_IS_DAMAGED_CONTENT: Currently, Postier does not provide built-in insurance. We are working to offer this in the future. For now, please ensure the sender provides secure packaging and photos before shipping. If issues arise, dispute resolution is available.
NEW.CANCEL_DELIVERY_RECEIVER: Can I cancel a delivery as a receiver?
NEW.CANCEL_DELIVERY_RECEIVER_CONTENT: You cannot cancel a delivery directly, but you can coordinate with the sender. Cancellation rules and refunds depend on the sender’s booking.
NEW.LEAVE_FEEDBACK_CONTENT: Yes, you can rate and review your delivery experience. Feedback helps ensure trust and quality on Postier.
NEW.URGENT_DELIVERY: What if I have urgent delivery needs?
NEW.URGENT_DELIVERY_CONTENT: Choose 'Express' or 'Same-Day' delivery options when creating your parcel request.
NEW.WHAT_ARE_PROHIBITED: What items are prohibited for shipping?
NEW.WHAT_ARE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT: Prohibited items include, but are not limited to: hazardous materials (e.g., explosives, flammable liquids), perishable goods (without proper packaging), animals, illegal substances, and currency or valuable items such as gold.
NEW.PICKUP_TIME_SCHEDULE: Can I schedule a specific pickup time for my parcel?
NEW.PICKUP_TIME_SCHEDULE_CONTENT: Yes, you can schedule a pickup at your convenience when creating a parcel. Enter your preferred date and time, and our postier will collect your parcel.
NEW.PACKAGING_USERFOR: What packaging should I use for my parcel?
NEW.PACKAGING_USERFOR_CONTENT: Use strong and appropriately sized packaging to protect your item during transit. Securely seal the package and add cushioning materials for fragile items.
NEW.HOW_DO_RECEIVE_PARCEL: How do I receive a parcel?
NEW.HOW_DO_RECEIVE_PARCEL_CONTENT: Once the sender creates and dispatches a parcel, you’ll receive a notification along with tracking details. You can monitor the parcel's journey and stay informed about the estimated delivery time. Make sure you're available at the delivery location or provide an authorized recipient if you’re unavailable.
NEW.CAN_I_TRACK_MY_INCOMING_PARCEL: Can I track my incoming parcel?
NEW.CAN_I_TRACK_MY_INCOMING_PARCEL_CONTENT: Yes! As soon as the sender confirms the parcel dispatch, you’ll receive a tracking ID. Use this ID on our platform to check real-time updates on your parcel’s status, from pickup to delivery.
NEW.WHAT_SHOULD_I_DO_IF_I_MISS_THE_DELIVERY: What should I do if I miss the delivery?
NEW.WHAT_SHOULD_I_DO_IF_I_MISS_THE_DELIVERY_: If you're not available at the time of delivery, the Postier will attempt to contact you or reschedule. You can also contact our support team or the sender to coordinate a redelivery or pickup from a nearby point.

DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.TITLE: How We Calculate Delivery Prices on Postier
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.SUB_TITLE: Postier uses a smart, fair pricing formula that combines:
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.PARCEL_BLK1_TITLE: Calculate actual weight and volumetric weight easily
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.PARCEL_BLK1_DESC: We always use the higher of actual weight and volumetric weight.
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.PARCEL_BLK2_DESC: The volumetric weight of the package amounts to 1.2kg.
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.DISTANCE_BLK1_DESC: Postier uses the Great Circle Distance formula to calculate the most direct distance between the pickup and drop-off locations. This method ensures fair and geographically accurate pricing for parcel deliveries—especially useful for cross-city, cross-country, and intercontinental trips.
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.DISTANCE_BLK2_DESC: The Great Circle Distance is the shortest path between two points on the surface of a sphere (like Earth). It accounts for the planet’s curvature, offering more precise results than flat, straight-line methods.
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.URGENCY_BLK1_DESC: The urgency level is applied after calculating the base rate and adjusted distance cost. Each urgency level corresponds to a specific multiplier that increases the price depending on how fast the delivery must be fulfilled.
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.DELIVERY_BLK1_DESC: At Postier, we understand that not all parcels are the same. Some require special handling, extra care, or specific transportation conditions. To ensure accurate pricing and fair compensation for Postiers, we apply Delivery Type Adjustments based on the nature of the parcel.
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.STANDARD_PARCEL_DESC1: Regular items that don’t need special care or handling
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.OVERSIZED_PACKAGES_DESC1: Bulky items that take up extra space or require effort to move
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.TEMPERATURE_SENSITIVE_DESC1: Items that must be kept within a certain temperature
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.FLAT_DESC: Discounts for long distances, heavier parcels, and larger dimensions!
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.FLAT_BLK1_TITLE: Flat Rate Pricing Model for Intercontinental Postiers
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.FLAT_BLK1_DESC: For Postiers traveling internationally, the pricing model is specially designed to reflect the realities of air travel while remaining fair and attractive to all parties involved.
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.FLAT_BLK2_TITLE: Long distances and high travel costs
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.FLAT_BLK2_DESC: Long distances and high travel costs are accounted for through base flat rates that ensure Postiers are meaningfully compensated.
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.FLAT_BLK3_DESC: Luggage limits and parcel constraints are considered by categorizing parcels into realistic size/weight brackets (Envelope, Small, Medium, Large, Trolley).
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.FLAT_BLK4_DESC: Balanced affordability ensures senders benefit from a cost-effective alternative to expensive international couriers.
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.FLAT_BLK5_DESC1: ⏱️ Urgency Level Multiplier – Extra earnings for Express or Same-Day deliveries
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.FLAT_BLK5_DESC2: 📦 Delivery Type Multiplier – Higher rates for handling fragile, oversized, or temperature-sensitive parcels
DELIVERY_CANCELLATION.FLAT_BLK5_DESC3: 🧳 Package Type Tiers – Flat rate per size/weight class, such as envelopes or full trolley bags

DYNAMIC_CALCULATION.DYNAMIC_BLK3_DESC: Volumetric weight or dimensional weight is a weight-measurement technique used in eCommerce logistics in which the weight of a package is calculated as the product of its length, breadth & height divided by a courier-specific constant. Your courier partner charges you based on the higher weight of the package out of the true weight & the dimensional weight.
DYNAMIC_CALCULATION.CONSIDER_INCREASE: Note: Consider increasing your price to better share your travel costs for this ride. You'll get bookings in no time!
DYNAMIC_CALCULATION.ERR_PICKUP_REQUIRED: Invalid or fill the pickup address
DYNAMIC_CALCULATION.ERR_DROP_REQUIRED: Invalid or fill the dropoff address
DYNAMIC_CALCULATION.ERR_DIMENSION_REQUIRED: Invalid or fill the length, width and height
DYNAMIC_CALCULATION.ERR_AVGPRICE_REQUIRED: Invalid or fill the average price
DYNAMIC_CALCULATION.ERR_URGENCY_REQUIRED: Invalid or fill the urgency level
DYNAMIC_CALCULATION.ERR_DELTYPE_REQUIRED: Invalid or fill the delivery type

CANCELLATION_POLICY.TITLE: Postier Cancellation Policy
CANCELLATION_POLICY.DESC: At Postier, we strive to offer a flexible and reliable delivery experience for senders, postiers, and receivers. We understand that plans may change, and cancellations might be necessary. This policy outlines the terms under which cancellations are allowed and how they are managed.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.SENDER_1: You may cancel your delivery at any time before pickup.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.SENDER_2: If a payment has already been processed, a partial refund may be applied based on the cancellation timing and delivery status.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.SENDER_3: If the Postier has already picked up the parcel, cancellation is no longer possible. Please contact our support team for help.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.POSTIER_1: You may cancel a trip prior to accepting any delivery requests without penalties.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.POSTIER_2: Once a parcel is accepted and scheduled for pickup, cancelling a trip may affect your reliability rating and ability to receive future requests.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.POSTIER_3: If unavoidable, please notify the sender as early as possible and contact support if assistance is needed.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.CANCELLATION_TIMING_1: More than 24 hours before scheduled pickup
CANCELLATION_POLICY.CANCELLATION_TIMING_3: After Postier has arrived at pickup point or started delivery
CANCELLATION_POLICY.POSTIER_IMPACT_3: Possible account review for repeated cases
CANCELLATION_POLICY.NOTE_1: Note: All refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5–7 business days. The exact refund amount will depend on whether the parcel has been accepted, picked up, or is already in transit.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.NOTE_2: All refunds are processed within 5–7 business days to your original payment method.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.HOW_TO_CANCEL_2: Go to My Trips or My Parcels.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.HOW_TO_CANCEL_4: Select Cancel and confirm your reason.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.HOW_TO_CANCEL_DESC1: To cancel your trip or delivery request:
CANCELLATION_POLICY.HOW_TO_CANCEL_DESC2: If you experience any issues during this process, our support team is always ready to help you via
CANCELLATION_POLICY.IMP_NOTES_1: Frequent or last-minute cancellations may lead to temporary suspension or account review.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.IMP_NOTES_2: If you feel your cancellation was unavoidable (e.g., emergency or fraud suspicion), please contact our support with relevant details.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.IMP_NOTES_3: In case of disputes, Postier may hold funds until the case is reviewed and resolved.
CANCELLATION_POLICY.OUR_COMMITMENT_DESC: Postier is committed to fairness and transparency. We aim to balance the flexibility users need with the reliability and trust required by our community. Thank you for helping us make Postier a secure and efficient platform.

PAYMENT_SUMMARY.TITLE: Payment Summary
PAYMENT_SUMMARY.CANCELLATION_POLICY_DESC: Free cancellation before 12 hours before the start of the parcel distribution time. After that the booking is no longer refundable. These deadlines always refer to the local time of the advert
PAYMENT_SUMMARY.POSTIER_SERVICE_FEE_DESC: Includes the applicable value added tax. To the VAT invoice.
PAYMENT_SUMMARY.HAVE_A_QUESTION_DESC: You can find details about payments and refunds in the section with your payments. Alternatively you can contact us in the help center.
PAYMENT_SUMMARY.POSTIER_PAYMENTS_DESC: Postier Payments is a limited payment processor of your host. This means that your payment obligation to the host is fulfilled by your payment of the total amount to Postier Payments. Refund requests will be processed in accordance with: (i) the Postier’s cancellation policy or (ii) the Rebooking and Refunds Policy, available at www.postier.org/terms.
